name: FaceZap
summary: Meet the jelly faces in FaceZap, a colorful block puzzle made for Meta Quest. Place pieces on the board, complete rows and columns, and chain satisfying combos. Build your ZAP bonus to open up new moves when the board gets crowded. Play in a vibrant virtual world or bring the board into your room with mixed reality. Use your controllers or hand tracking, reposition the board, and play seated or standing. Enjoy a familiar puzzle with expressive jelly characters and smooth reactions.
